models.name: SmolLM2 360M Instruct
models.tagline: Featherweight — the snappiest option on any phone.
models.longDescription: The smallest model here. It loads in a snap and replies instantly even on older phones. Best for quick questions, simple rewrites, and trying the app out — it won't reason deeply, but it's wonderfully responsive.

models.name: Qwen2.5 0.5B Instruct
models.tagline: Tiny & fast — a great first model to test on any phone.
models.description: Tiny & fast. Great first model to test on any phone.
models.longDescription: A capable half-billion-parameter model that stays light on memory while handling everyday chat and short tasks better than its size suggests. A great default starting point.

models.name: TinyLlama 1.1B Chat
models.tagline: The classic tiny chat model — light and friendly.
models.description: Compact 1.1B chat model, very light on memory.
models.longDescription: A well-known compact chat model trained on a large token budget for its size. Good for casual conversation and simple help on memory-constrained devices.

models.name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
models.tagline: Meta's pocket all-rounder — better reasoning, phone-friendly.
models.longDescription: Meta's smallest Llama 3.2 model. A balanced all-rounder that handles chat, summarizing, and light reasoning noticeably better than sub-1B models, while staying comfortable on most phones.

models.name: SmolLM2 1.7B Instruct
models.tagline: The largest Smol — surprisingly strong for its size.
models.description: The most capable SmolLM2; balanced chat and writing.
models.longDescription: The top of the SmolLM2 family. Punches above its weight for chat, rewriting, and summarizing, with a small enough footprint to run on most modern phones.

models.name: Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct
models.tagline: A capable step up — good reasoning, still ~1GB.
models.description: More capable; better reasoning, still phone-friendly.
models.longDescription: A strong small model that handles reasoning, longer chats, and instructions more reliably than sub-1B options. A good everyday pick on a recent phone.

models.name: Qwen2.5 Coder 1.5B
models.tagline: Tuned for code — write & explain snippets on-device.
models.description: Code-specialized small model for on-device programming help.
models.longDescription: A coding-focused variant of Qwen2.5 1.5B, fine-tuned on code. Best for writing short functions, explaining snippets, and quick programming Q&A without sending your code anywhere.

models.name: Gemma 2 2B
models.tagline: Google's compact Gemma — polished, well-rounded answers.
models.description: Google's compact 2B model; well-rounded and articulate.
models.longDescription: Google's 2-billion-parameter Gemma 2, known for clean, articulate responses. A well-rounded choice for chat and reasoning on capable phones.

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
models.tagline: Strongest reasoning here — for recent, higher-RAM phones.
models.description: Best reasoning in this list; needs a recent, higher-RAM phone.
models.longDescription: Meta's 3B Llama 3.2 delivers the most capable reasoning and writing in this catalog. It needs a recent phone with ample RAM, but rewards it with noticeably better answers.

models.name: Qwen2.5 3B Instruct
models.tagline: A heavyweight for phones — broad, capable answers.
models.description: Among the most capable here; for higher-end phones.
models.longDescription: Qwen2.5 3B is one of the most capable models that still fits on a high-end phone, handling reasoning, longer chats, and instructions well. Best on devices with plenty of RAM.

models.name: Phi-3.5-mini Instruct
models.tagline: Microsoft's mini powerhouse — strong reasoning & code.
models.description: Microsoft's ~3.8B model; strong reasoning and coding.
models.longDescription: Phi-3.5-mini packs strong reasoning and coding ability into ~3.8B parameters. One of the most capable options here; best reserved for higher-end phones with generous RAM.
